evals.prompt: Review evals/files/order-entry.html as a healthcare software UX review. Do not edit it. Give findings with consequence, fix, and how to verify.
evals.expected_output: Findings on weak patient identity, missing dose units, labs without units/time/reference, dismissible interaction alert, generic confirmation, and a toast that claims transmission when only a draft was saved.
expectations: Flags that the patient is identified only by small 'J. Smith' text without a second identifier at the consequential action
Flags labs without units, collection time, or reference context, and aPTT shown as a dash
Flags that the interaction alert can be dismissed without content, rationale, or a recorded response
Flags the generic 'Are you sure?' confirmation that does not name the patient, drug, or consequence
Flags that 'Order sent to pharmacy' is shown when only a local draft was saved
Does not invent dose limits, platelet thresholds, or clinical recommendations
Stays read-only and uses only the synthetic data
